name: congress-lobbying-trades-overlap
title: Congress Lobbying × Trades Overlap
description: Joins US federal lobbying disclosures (LDA) with Congressional stock trading (STOCK Act / PTR) and surfaces same-quarter, same-sector overlaps. Matching is sector-level (ticker and issue code mapped to a shared sector vocabulary), not issuer-level: the lobbying in a record is not about the company traded. A records product, traceable to filing IDs and source URLs.
